name: Castelvecchio di Rocca Barbena (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castelvecchio di Rocca Barbena (the letters CRB, a mountain and red and white chequy) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CASTELVECCHIO DI ROCCA BARBENA in red arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Castelvecchio di Rocca Barbena, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castelvecchio di Rocca Barbena arms — letters CRB, a mountain and red and white chequy, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CASTELVECCHIO DI ROCCA BARBENA arched above the arms
